refresh-interval.tooltip: How often the applet refreshes usage data with 'ocgo refresh'.

ocgo-path.tooltip: Path to the ocgo executable. Leave empty to use ~/.local/bin/ocgo or the ocgo found in PATH.

show-credits.tooltip: Show the credits balance, extra usage, and auto-recharge in the popup (OpenCode login accounts only).

active-account.tooltip: The account the meter shows; selecting one runs 'ocgo account use'.

accounts-apply-button.tooltip: Add an API-key account, or replace the key of an existing one. The key is validated by the ocgo CLI and never stored in the applet settings.

accounts-remove-button.tooltip: Remove the account selected above. Removing an API-key account also deletes its stored key.
